title: When Ecological Representations Stop Travelling
subtitle: State, evidence, revision, loss, and warning in a task-indexed theory universe
core_question: When does a scientific representation that is adequate for one ecological task cease to be reusable after capability, future grammar, structural replacement, mechanism responsibility, evidence, target, representation, or domain changes?
editorial_principle: Lead with the strongest non-obvious forbidden inference, treat each source programme as a distinct transport-failure problem, embed bridge/firewall theorems in the chapters where they do scientific work, and reserve theouni for synthesis rather than source-theorem ownership.
claim_ceiling: This file selects an editorial traversal intended to maximize dissertation novelty; it does not impose a privileged order on the underlying theory universe.
Source theorem ownership remains with CREST, CCOC, MLTR, MRM, CED, RACH, eco-genetic-criticality, and eco-genetic-warning-extensions.
TU-2, TU-3, and TU-4 are bridge or firewall modules embedded in source-owned scientific chapters rather than promoted as independent novelty chapters.
TU-1 is used in the General Synthesis as the revision-after-compression result; it becomes an independent research chapter only after a stronger carrier-changing revision result is established.
The architecture does not convert open empirical bridges, pairwise non-conflict, or bounded witnesses into global theory or empirical validation claims.

general_introduction.title: The Reuse Problem in Ecology
general_introduction.role: Pose the problem of transporting a state, law, measurement, or warning beyond the task for which it was built, while introducing only the minimum task-factorization vocabulary and universe-wide invariants.
general_introduction.headline_question: When may a scientific representation be reused for another ecological responsibility?
must_not_do: Do not begin with a catalogue of repositories or nine state definitions.
Do not present purpose relativity, partition refinement, or factorization as the dissertation's principal novelty.
Do not reveal the complete theouni synthesis before the source-owned failures have done their scientific work.

parts.title: When Doing More Requires Knowing More
parts.part_conclusion: Expanding what can happen or what can be done need not produce a commensurate increase in what can be represented with the old state or interface.

chapters.title: When Conservation Capacity Outgrows Conservation Knowledge
chapters.headline_result: For every m >= 1, one newly admitted controllable action can add exactly one viable world while forcing a retained present slice to refine from one state to 2^m states, producing exactly m bits of monitoring debt under unchanged evidence.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: small intervention or capability gain => small required-state or monitoring burden
chapters.novelty_role: Open the dissertation with the strongest conservation-facing no-bound result rather than with a general framework definition.
chapters.ecological_payoff: Intervention scale may be an administrative budgeting variable, but it cannot by itself certify adequate monitoring resolution.
chapters.transition_question: How can one newly available action expose arbitrarily many distinctions hidden by the previous representation?

chapters.title: When Closed Simplicity Fails under Open Futures
chapters.headline_result: Exact interfaces that are constant-sized under fixed closed response grammars can require exponentially more states or m additional bits under a jointly opened future grammar.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: simple exact interfaces under each closed grammar => a simple exact interface under the open grammar
chapters.novelty_role: Provide the cross-grammar structural mechanism beneath capability-resolution divergence without collapsing CCOC into CREST.
chapters.ecological_payoff: A model or monitoring interface calibrated under fixed compositions need not remain adequate when colonization, reconnection, or new interventions become legal.
chapters.transition_question: Even when future exposure is understood, can a scientific law survive when the ecological system itself is replaced?

parts.title: When Scientific Laws Fail to Travel
parts.part_conclusion: A law may fail to transport because inherited meaning is broken by replacement or because unresolved mechanisms imply different required responses.

chapters.title: When Macro-Laws Do Not Survive Ecological Replacement
chapters.headline_result: A declared source macro-law transports exactly under source-target coherence conditions; otherwise a unique coarsest source-relative repair, transport defect, and minimal history augmentation can be constructed.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: an exact source macro-law => the same exact macro-law after turnover, recolonization, extinction, or rewiring
chapters.novelty_role: Distinguish source-relative semantic repair from unconstrained target re-aggregation and from CCOC's independently optimized closed/open minima.
chapters.ecological_payoff: State labels and macro-laws may retain or lose operational meaning after non-nested ecological replacement, and the least repair can be quantified.
chapters.transition_question: What if the visible system is unchanged, but several hidden mechanisms still imply different intervention responses?

chapters.title: When Visible Equivalence Fails under Mechanism Uncertainty
chapters.headline_result: A candidate-independent deterministic law exists exactly when retained mechanism response types agree; otherwise the honest outputs are typed or set-valued and the coarsest candidate-safe quotient retains only response-relevant mechanism distinctions.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: same visible state => same deterministic intervention law
chapters.novelty_role: Make response type, rather than full mechanism identity or visible state alone, the criterion for mechanism-safe ecological law.
chapters.ecological_payoff: Mechanism uncertainty matters only where it changes the response demanded by the scientific task, but it cannot be erased when it does.
chapters.transition_question: Once the necessary distinctions are known in principle, has the observation system actually earned them?

parts.title: When More Information Does Not Give the Needed Answer
parts.part_conclusion: Required resolution, target licensing, causal learning, and reliability-qualified evidence are distinct scientific achievements and may rank observations differently.

chapters.title: When Evidence Does Not License the State We Need
chapters.headline_result: Finite experiment records induce compatible-world classes; deterministic reporting is licensed exactly when the target is constant on the relevant class, while trustworthy refinement depends on failure architecture and explicit false-resolution control.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: more, finer, or nominally distinguishing information => a licensed ecological target
chapters.novelty_role: Turn state adequacy into a failure-aware reporting problem rather than treating additional data or full-world information as automatically useful.
chapters.ecological_payoff: Repeated effort within one shared failure domain is not equivalent to independent observation modes, and full state identification is unnecessary when the target is already constant.
chapters.transition_question: If the present evidence leaves several causal programmes alive, which observation should be collected next?

chapters.title: When Learning the Cause and Licensing the Decision Diverge
chapters.headline_result: RACH retains all causal programmes compatible with the declared model, constraints, and observations and selects measurements by validated next-observation value; TU-2 proves that causal-learning value and target-licensing status can vary independently and reverse experiment rankings.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: pattern fit or high causal-learning value => identified cause or licensed decision target
chapters.novelty_role: Pair an executable next-observation method with a formal firewall showing that learning explanation and licensing action are different estimands.
chapters.ecological_payoff: The observation most useful for understanding mechanism need not be the observation that resolves the immediate conservation decision, and vice versa.
chapters.transition_question: How do these distinctions affect claims about ecological loss and early warning in an explicit dynamic system?

parts.title: When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
parts.part_conclusion: Warning is meaningful only after the loss-generating state is fixed independently, and temporal precedence alone does not establish discrimination or portability.

chapters.title: Which State Actually Generates Functional Loss?
chapters.headline_result: The complete explicit simulator state is future-sufficient under the declared closure, but common ecological and genetic marginals can hide transition-relevant cross-layer alignment; TU-3 separates raw simulator representation from the contract-complete loss-generating quotient.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: raw simulator detail or matching coarse eco-genetic marginals => the correct loss-generating state
chapters.novelty_role: Ground the representation theory in a dynamic eco-genetic system where joint spatial structure, not a generic state slogan, changes the next transition.
chapters.ecological_payoff: Loss and warning analyses must condition on a state representation that preserves the complete declared loss response rather than on convenient marginal summaries.
chapters.transition_question: Once the loss domain is frozen warning-blind, does a signal that consistently appears before loss actually discriminate impending loss?

chapters.title: When an Early Signal Is Not a Warning
chapters.headline_result: Baseline-relative genetic erosion preceded realized loss in all inherited and fresh event trajectories, yet the same thresholds fired in all audited non-event trajectories, yielding zero specificity and AUC 0.5; TU-4 separates LossGeneratingState from WarningEvaluationState and within-state validity from portability.
chapters.primary_forbidden_inference: signal precedes loss => the signal is a valid or portable warning
chapters.novelty_role: End the empirical arc with a reproduced temporal ordering that fails prediction, making state conditioning, full denominators, and portability scientifically unavoidable rather than decorative cautions.
chapters.ecological_payoff: A warning must discriminate events from non-events within a warning-adequate state and must pass a separate transport test before becoming a cross-system indicator.
chapters.transition_question: After building task-adequate representations across the dissertation, can any of them be reused when the scientific responsibility later changes?

general_synthesis.title: The Theory Universe: Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction of Travel
general_synthesis.headline_result: A revised state Q is recoverable from an old stored state P exactly when q_Q factors through q_P; otherwise TU-1 quantifies the exact same-carrier auxiliary revision debt and shows that worst local revisability burden can diverge arbitrarily from average global refinement.
general_synthesis.primary_forbidden_inference: a representation adequate for the original task => a representation revisable for a later task
general_synthesis.novelty_role: Recover the dissertation as a typed theory of transport, non-transport, and revision across task-indexed worldlines without claiming that all source results are one theorem.
general_synthesis.synthesis_claim: The common object is not one privileged ecological state but the family of explicit bridge conditions governing whether a state, law, evidence claim, causal result, loss representation, or warning may travel to another scientific responsibility.
general_synthesis.independent_chapter_upgrade_condition: Promote TU-1 to a ninth research chapter only after a nontrivial carrier-changing revision theorem is established and distinguished from MLTR source-target transport.

novelty_firewalls: Do not title the dissertation as a unified theory of ecological state alone; foreground transport failure and reuse boundaries.
Do not count purpose relativity, quotient construction, partition refinement, or fixed-task factorization as separate novelty contributions.
Give each research chapter one primary forbidden inference and one source-owned result that makes that prohibition nontrivial.
Do not create standalone TU-2, TU-3, or TU-4 chapters; their value is the exact bridge or firewall they provide inside an ecological result.
Do not let the General Synthesis re-own source theorems or erase the distinctions among future, history, mechanism, evidence, learning, loss, and warning.
Do not claim global consistency from pairwise non-conflict or two bounded triadic witnesses.
Do not infer empirical natural-state adequacy without the Reality-to-Theory admission bridge.
